high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Kendall Jenner. The post features a photograph of Kendall Jenner hiking on a rocky trail in Yosemite National Park. She is wearing a black cap, a black sports bra, black shorts, and black athletic shoes with white socks. She has a backpack on her back, suggesting she is prepared for a hike. The setting is a natural, outdoor environment with large rocks, greenery, and a waterfall in the background. The trail appears to be well-trodden but challenging, with uneven terrain and a steep drop-off to the right side of the image.
